'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Richards DS Fear Is My Ally''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
